title: Ty Beanie Baby Original Prickles the Hedgehog 1999 - Retired
descriptionText: The Ty Retired Beanie Original Baby Prickles the Hedgehog from 1999 is a collectible plush toy from the Beanie Babies line. Made by Ty in China, this Beanie Baby is part of the character family of Beanie Babies and is recommended for ages 3 and up. This specific hedgehog toy features the iconic Ty brand and is a sought-after item for collectors of vintage Beanie Babies.
